scientific_integrity_and_limitations: The one-step theorem uses direct analytic arguments and numerical consistency checks, without independent validation. Generic fold/cubic singularity mechanisms and the sine-map invertibility boundary are classical. The full text of the motivating 2026 preprint was not accessible; historical-priority verification is therefore incomplete. No long-time synchronization, invariant density or frequency-averaged closure is asserted.
title: Sharp one-step regularity transition of Poisson phase laws under a sinusoidal circle kick
